
```{r echo=FALSE}
Vs30_TARGET <- 250
TR_TARGET <- 10000


CAP <-  "Horizontal seismic (pseudo-static) coefficients for AEP ranging between 1/100 to 1/10,000 yr. Values obtained assuming a target residual displacement Da=%g cm and soil site conditions with  Vs30=%g  m/s (Quantile p=%s)."
```

## Seismic Coefficients for MDE - Large residual displacements

::: {.panel-tabset}
### p=mean

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
p_TARGET <- "mean"
Da_TARGET <- 25
Caption <- sprintf(CAP,Da_TARGET,Vs30_TARGET,p_TARGET)
TBL <- KIT[ Da==Da_TARGET &  TR==TR_TARGET & Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & p==p_TARGET]
TBL |> buildTable(library="gt",font.size.body = 12,font.size.header = 14,font.bold.header=TRUE, caption=Caption)

```


### p=5%

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
p_TARGET <- 0.05
Da_TARGET <- 25
Caption <- sprintf(CAP,Da_TARGET,Vs30_TARGET,p_TARGET)

TBL <- KIT[ Da==Da_TARGET &  TR==TR_TARGET & Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & p==p_TARGET]
TBL |> buildTable(library="gt",font.size.body = 12,font.size.header = 14,font.bold.header=TRUE, caption=Caption)

```
